title: Discovering The Science Around Us
summary: Looking for fun things to do in Cambridge this weekend with your kids? Head to Cambridge Science Centre to investigate the extraordinary properties of man-made materials in our 'Marvellous Man-Made Materials' show. Witness the effects of a vacuum chamber on Marsha the marshmallow, explore the conductive and fireproof properties of different materials and observe how materials interact with different types of light. Join us to see how marvellous man-made materials keep us safe, cool, and capable

title: STEMtots – Light and Shadows
summary: Light up your Friday! Come and explore light and shadows using torches and investigate materials which reflect the light. Perfect for curious under-5s to play, learn, and feel a bit of science. STEMtots is our weekly relaxed, free-flow session for preschoolers, designed to encourage curiosity through hands-on fun.
